goals: Verify that the filterTasks function correctly filters a list of tasks based on include or exclude criteria, and returns the unmodified list when no valid filter is specified.
activities: Set up an array of five task objects
Call filterTasks with no filter specified
Assert that the returned array equals the original tasks array
Set up an array of five task objects
Call filterTasks with an empty filter list
Assert that the returned array equals the original tasks array
Set up an array of five task objects
Call filterTasks with an 'exclude' filter for a specific task
Assert that the length of the returned array is 4
Set up an array of five task objects
Call filterTasks with an 'include' filter for a specific task
Assert that the length of the returned array is 1
